mls.security_notice: This library has been validated for conformance to the RFC 9420 specification but has not yet received a full security audit by a 3rd party.
mls.conformance_claim_owner: upstream; not an independent Memoshi qualification

modifications: Cargo path dependencies resolve to the same immutable upstream git revision.

Replacement build.rs directly invokes installed xcrun swiftc for macOS27/iOS27/simulator arm64, emits a static library, and links Apple runtime/frameworks; no nested SwiftPM manifest or tool installation.
Swift AEAD and KEM entrypoints return provider failure instead of forced-try traps; invalid numeric algorithm IDs fail without forced unwrap.
Swift signature import validates Ed25519 64-byte private-plus-public representation; empty NIST public inputs and overlong private inputs do not index or negative-pad trap.
Swift HKDF expansion enforces the RFC HKDF output-length bound.
Only source files used by the provider are imported; unconsumed upstream SwiftPM packaging and its test target are not retained.

binding.implementation: Memoshi-owned Native/src wrapper around unmodified pinned mls-rs, with a custom authenticated device IdentityProvider
binding.upstream_uniffi_wrapper_boundary: Upstream mls-rs-uniffi0.14 hardcodes OpenSSL; importing it would violate the selected CryptoKit provider. This adapter uses UniFFI directly, not an OpenSSL substitution.
binding.runtime_object_membership: Not asserted from source metadata: uniffi_pipeline is an unconditional normal dependency, even though described as codegen/CLI. Actual static-link/dead-strip membership requires artifact evidence.
binding.identity_binding: A host device-only Noise Ed25519 key signs domain-separated device ID, signing/agreement public keys and the independently generated MLS Ed25519 public key. The signed certificate is the MLS BasicCredential and is validated for every member. A KeyPackage must additionally equal the QR/Noise-authenticated peer supplied by the host.
binding.group_context_binding: Actual mls-rs RFC GroupContext encoding (including tree and confirmed transcript hashes) is returned for active and staged target states. Active commit acceptance requires exact authority target-context equality; a newcomer compares its native Welcome-joined context with the QR/authority anchor. An inactive removal tombstone only preserves authority target bytes: it cannot independently certify the new native epoch because the removed client receives no new secrets.
host_responsibilities: Authenticate and CAS-order exact commit bytes, target GroupContext and resulting roster/leaf indices
Encrypt secret snapshots under a device-only Keychain key
Fsync snapshots atomically with host inbox/outbox/authority records
Do not roll back acknowledged state or MLS-open a durable inbox receipt twice
